correctness.rationale: The quadrics are basepoint-free, and ampleness of their pullback hyperplane class excludes positive-dimensional fibers. On XYZ≠0 the stated rational inverse is regular; alternatively the quartic is irreducible as a primitive linear polynomial in W. This gives the normalization. Away from the triple point on X=1, use A=k[a,r,r^{-1}], B=k[y,z,w]/(F|_{X=1}), with y=a/r, z=a. The element r generates A over B with basis of generators 1,r; r y=z and r z=w z+(z²+1)y show that (y,z) kills its class in A/B. Modulo a, the quotient k[r,r^{-1}]/k[r+r^{-1}] is free of rank one over k[r+r^{-1}], generated by r modulo the subring, so no extra annihilator occurs. At the triple point the three completed normalized branches are graphs with three independent transverse linear normals: on s=1 the Y/W and Z/W coordinates have independent linear terms, and cyclically. Their three local equations are therefore formal parameters a,b,c; the completed reduced surface is abc=0 (completion embeds into the product of the three smooth completed normalization rings). Each graph contains the two corresponding target axes, so the smooth pairwise intersections are the formal target axes. In abc=0 the branch restrictions of conductor elements must vanish along both axes of each branch: multiplying by branch idempotents forces this, and the restrictions vanishing there can be lifted separately by ab,bc,ca. Thus the conductor is the reduced pairwise-intersection ideal; its restriction to a branch is the reduced product ideal, as required also at the vertices. On a double line, w=(r+1)²/r, hence the index at r=1 is 2 and ord(dw/dr)=2 there; the poles at 0 and ∞ are simple and the rest are unramified. Substituting v=(r+1)/w gives v²+v=1/w. The affine minors generate (a,(r+1)²), and the triple-point preimages have rank 2, so exactly three length-two loci occur. Counting the complements of the triangle and of the three concurrent lines gives q²+q+2. The image of v↦v²+v is precisely the absolute trace-zero subspace; each line misses q/2 points away from w=0 and the common point, giving the claimed deficit and image count. Independent replay: python3 /workspace/branches/review_checks.py 4 verifies the exact line fiber/trace pattern at q=2,4,8,16,32,64. The frozen checker was read, not executed.
residual_risks: The finite-field replay does not prove the formal conductor or rank-drop scheme; those use local ring and differential computations. The Jacobian singularity scheme is different.

value.rationale: The actual normalization conductor controls how this nonnormal surface is obtained by gluing its normalized branches, including the crossing where separate generic double-line calculations do not suffice. Establishing reducedness on both sides of the normalization gives a precise gluing invariant beyond the known Jacobian critical phenomena. The arithmetic stratification distinguishes rational points on the surface from points in the normalization image, and illustrates that the reduced conductor does not imply rational lifting.
residual_risks: Scope is the displayed charateristic-two split surface; the arithmetic count has not been extended to twists. Value is not assigned to a repeat of the already known total surface count.
